title: What one game version offers parents
description: Published by each game version (PUT /v1/games/{game}/manifests/{code}). The parent app draws controls, names and skill lists from it, so a new game or setting needs no parent app release. A control the child's installed version lacks (since_code above its code) is greyed out with "update the game to use this". Level and world unlocks are left out on purpose: parents do not move children through the game.

scope.description: Default child_game. device settings (volume) never sync.

skills.description: Skill ids this version can ask, from skills.json.

labels.description: World and area ids to display names.

levels.description: Permanent level ids and where they sit, for reports.

pictures.description: Profile picture ids, in the order the game offers them. The parent app shows web/pictures/<game>/<id>.png for each.

picture_labels.description: Optional (added 2026-11-21): picture id to a display name, like "phoenix": "Blaze". The parent app shows the id itself when a name is missing.
